description: Pinned upstream provenance and tested tool versions for ce-beads. Upstream checkouts are implementation provenance only (read-only, gitignored) and are NOT required at runtime — the skill invokes the `bd` CLI from PATH. Machine-specific paths (binary locations, local DB/workspace state) are intentionally omitted; see `docs/local-environment.md` (gitignored) for a local environment report.

compound-engineering-plugin.commit_subject: fix: name what document identifiers refer to in rendered findings and POVs (#1198)
compound-engineering-plugin.purpose: Implementation provenance. The inspected contract files defined the CE plan schema that plan-parser.ts and graph-builder.ts target. Not read at runtime.

beads.commit_subject: feat(validate): typed length bounds for assignee, owner, and label (#4894)
beads.purpose: Implementation provenance. The inspected contract files defined the bd CLI surface (graph_apply, init, create, list, update, dep, ready, show, close, metadata, types) that beads-client.ts wraps. Not read at runtime — runtime uses the `bd` binary on PATH.

dev_workspace_init.note: The development workspace is initialized at `.beads/` (gitignored) via `bd init` with no explicit database name; bd derives defaults. Database name, issue prefix, and backend are bd-managed runtime state, not pinned inventory.
